blog.body:
Your title is the first thing a buyer sees — and the first thing eBay's search reads. The mistakes we see most often:

1. Wasting words on 'hot', 'sale' or 'best quality' instead of what the product actually is.
2. No size, material or compatibility — the exact words buyers type.
3. Keywords stuffed in a random order, so the title reads badly and gets skipped.
4. Copying a competitor's title, which buries you under their listing.
5. Forgetting the sold-listing check: titles of items that actually sold tell you which words work.

Fix these five and the same product usually gets more clicks without spending a penny on ads. Our Trial Pack rewrites 5 listings with keyword titles built from sold-listing research.

blog.body:
Guesswork is expensive. Real product research follows a simple chain:

First, we look at sold listings — not active ones. An item listed 500 times but sold 3 times is a trap, not a trend.

Second, we check the sell-through rate and the average sold price, so the margin survives fees, shipping and returns.

Third, we study the top sellers of that product: their titles, photos and shipping offers show the standard you have to beat.

Only then does a product earn a place on the shortlist. This is exactly the research inside our Best Seller and Store Growth packages — you get the report, not just listings.

blog.body:
There is no single best marketplace — there is a best first marketplace for your situation.

eBay is the fastest place to start: low entry cost, every category welcome, and quick feedback on what sells.

Amazon brings the biggest traffic, but it demands more — brand rules, FBA logistics and stricter account health.

Walmart sits in between: less competition than Amazon, serious buyers, and WFS fulfilment once you are approved.

Our honest advice: start where your product already fits, prove the sales, then expand. VeerCommerce manages all three — plus Shopify, Etsy, TikTok Shop and Wayfair — so your growth plan can stay with one team.
